title: Fantastic Tour, Worth the Money
text: If you visit Barcelona, I highly recommend this tour! David was really kind, personable and had so much knowledge to share. It was really cool to learn about the history of Catalan from a local and to visit culturally significant places that I would not have found otherwise. My boyfriend really enjoyed learning about the architectural history and you get to see one of Gaudi's lesser known designs!
author: 264allyt

title: The Grace built by people
text: David told me about the Grace that has resulted after the passage of so many people. The Vila made from the bottom up, the one that sprouted from the movement of its neighbors. David has more to tell. I encourage you to participate in the tour.
author: manuel_f

title: David, the best
text:
It was a truly fantastic tour in the heart of Barcelona, in the Gràcia district. I absolutely loved it — it was amazing.
David,
The information you shared was incredible — it was packed with knowledge and full of experiences. The tour itself felt very easygoing and natural. Everything you explained was completely clear and easy to follow.
And at the end, the vermouth was really the cherry on top. The place was fantastic, and the vermouth itself was excellent too. Thank you so much for this unforgettable experience.❤️🙏
author: Tigre490

title: Wonderful Experience! Highly Recommend This Gràcia Tour
text:
We had an absolutely fantastic time on this tour of the Gràcia neighborhood! David was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the area's rich history and vibrant local culture. Gràcia has a completely different, bohemian vibe compared to the rest of Barcelona, and this tour captured it perfectly. From the charming hidden plazas to the amazing local stories, every minute was engaging.
Very recommended
author: F1407RVdiegoc

title: Surprising local neighborhood
text: What we did during the tour was nothing special; we visited some local squares and only one or two important landmarks. The thing that made the tour special is the storytelling: the guide made us live history as if it was happening right there. Even though we were only two in the group, it was never awkward and the ending was great. We could enjoy a drink and some local food with him and have a moment of stillness and good conversation, which is unusual in a trip these days. Thank you, it was a great experience!
author: Tourist10744031285

title: Unforgettable experience
text:
This was an unforgettable experience! This tour made my trip so much better and I truly appreciate all the effort David put to keep us informed and entertained. He turned all the seemingly boring or uninteresting parts of the tour into a funny and engaging story that kept us all hooked.
It is absolutely worth it, and not only will you make great memories and photos, but the "vermut" experience truly makes you feel like you're part of the city.
author: I5305FGdavidm

title: An incredible experience with a great ending
text: I came expecting a traditional tour: "look at this, this is blablabla". What I got was great storytelling from a professional actor and he was super nice! He made the experience immersive and I loved it. At the end, we could enjoy an amazing drink "vermut", but not only this: it included chips, olives and (the best part) what they call "secallona". I hope I'm writing it correctly. Overall, I would definitely recommend.
author: W6869EEpaolam

title: Visiting the local side of Barcelona on my own
text:
I joined this tour on my own and it was one of the nicest experiences I had in Barcelona. Gràcia feels very different from the busy city centre, and David did a great job explaining the history of the neighbourhood, its squares, local traditions and everyday life. It never felt like a generic tour. The vermouth at the end was a perfect way to finish and chat a bit more. 
Highly recommended if you want to see a more authentic side of Barcelona.
author: alexmE6468JC

title: Culture without rushing
text: The pace was easy to follow, the area was beautiful, and David explained the history of Gràcia in a clear and engaging way. We went with two teenagers and we were worried that they wouldn't have non alcoholic options, as they are not specified, but we could contact in advance and they included a coke for each. It was a pleasant moment!
author: montserratcX7577TR

title: Fun, relaxed and very local
text: We were a group of friends visiting Barcelona and this tour was a great break from the more touristy areas. The Gràcia quarter has a completely different atmosphere. David's stories helped us understand a bit more the history of this wonderful neighbourhood and of the whole city. It was a really enjoyable experience and the vermouth at the end didn't hurt!
